behavior: RMB click and Enter finish an open length measurement; only explicit left click on first point closes an area. Geometry is clipped at near plane and drawn in eye space with scene depth retained; labels draw after geometry. Path previews use unsaved editor-owned renderers, avoid repeated draw submission, and restore committed output visibility after each Scene render. Audio subtitle removed. Existing palette, point and pill styles retained.
limits: Windows D3D11 and the two recorded Unity versions only.
Mouse interaction assertions use SceneView.SendEvent; no claim of physical desktop right-drag verification.
Floating-point storage remains unchanged; extreme coordinates can still limit point position precision.
Preview helpers contain only mesh/render components and are excluded from scene serialization. Generate commits outputs.
regressionReproduction: The published 0.6.4 baseline fails RMB completion. Intermediate native-stroke attempts reproduce perspective broken/spiked lines at (100000,10000,100000); final eye-space rendering passes all sampled frames. Transparent-repeat fixture also passed 0.6.4 and is a regression guard, not a claimed baseline failure.
